summary: Man tubing the St. Vrain River in Lyons (3900 block of Ute Hwy) stranded on a concrete river diversion; two other tubers in the party also had to be rescued from the west bank of the North St. Vrain River in Meadow Park; Longmont Emergency Unit water-rescue swimmers pulled the 32-year-old out, hospitalized with non-life-threatening injuries; Boulder County Sheriff's Office and Lyons Fire Protection District rescued the other two.
location: St. Vrain River, Lyons (3900 block of Ute Hwy)
responding_agency: Longmont Emergency Unit; Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Lyons Fire Protection District
notes: Saturday-verified date; BW police-blotter item "Trapped tuber"; run 712.
